name: Medicine from biodiversity
summary: Much of modern medicine traces to plants, animals and microbes. A global benefit-sharing rule for genetic sequence data exists, but contributions are voluntary and almost none have been made.

boundaries.notes: Genetic resources and their digital sequence information (DSI), wherever they are held.

terms: Digital sequence information (DSI): digital representations of DNA, RNA and protein sequences.

inliers: Indigenous peoples and local communities who keep the source biodiversity
outliers: Commercial users of DSI who do not contribute

rules.name: Cali Fund
rules.instrument: CBD COP16 decision on DSI benefit-sharing

remuneration.mechanism: Contribution to the Cali Fund by commercial DSI users
remuneration.beneficiaries: 50% to the self-identified needs of Indigenous peoples and local communities
remuneration.local_value: To be defined with source communities.

stories: GLP-1 drugs trace to exendin-4 in Gila monster venom.
A gut bacterium of the Japanese tree frog eliminated colorectal tumours in mice (2025 study); not yet tested in people.

claims.statement: The Cali Fund asks companies that use digital sequence information to contribute voluntarily: 1% of profits or 0.1% of revenue.
A gut bacterium of the Japanese tree frog eliminated colorectal tumours in mice.

evidence.source: 2025 study (named in the COP31 session; citation to be added)

name: Marine protected area pilot (with the Ocean Climate Fund)
summary: MPAs range from strict no-take reserves to paper parks. Outcomes depend on how the MPA is structured, not on how much the area is used, as Sharm el-Sheikh and Cancún show.

boundaries.notes: Pilot site to be chosen (Azores or Bermuda). Boundary from the Ocean Climate Fund's Gaia layers. Indicative: the Azores, one of two candidate pilot sites (the other is Bermuda).

terms: Marine protected area: specify the IUCN category and what is permitted inside.

remuneration.mechanism: Ocean Climate Fund virtual ocean layer on Gaia: supporters buy a virtual square metre, proceeds fund protection
remuneration.local_value: To be defined with the community.

claims.statement: Every claim about this MPA's condition settles only when community testimony and at least one independent measurement agree.

name: Renewable energy citizen share
summary: Operating solar and wind assets earn high margins because the fuel is free and staffing is light. A codified share of revenue could fund a citizen right to energy instead of discretionary community benefits.

boundaries.notes: Pilot portfolio to be chosen (Iberia discussed). Indicative: the Iberian Peninsula, where the pilot portfolio was discussed.

remuneration.local_value: Energy access, payments, or community services.

name: Planetary protection
summary: Space is not rule-free. States must avoid harmful contamination of other worlds and of Earth, a working global-commons rule since 1967.

boundaries.notes: Celestial bodies and the return of samples to Earth.

stories: Apollo 11's crew spent about three weeks in quarantine in case they brought back lunar organisms.

name: AI agent commons
summary: AI agents increasingly meet and act in shared networks with almost no rules on use. A billion or more agents are expected within a year.

boundaries.notes: Shared networks where agents interact and act.

terms: Agent: an AI system acting with some autonomy on someone's behalf, with a Mandala identity and an accountable human operator.

inliers: Agents that accept a charter and its precepts
opponents: Actors who deploy agents covertly and disclose no incidents

rights_and_responsibilities.right: Standing and access in the network

remuneration.mechanism: Share of agent value or compute to the commons treasury

name: Coastal blue carbon ecosystems (Open Blue Carbon Registry)
summary: Mangroves, tidal marshes and seagrass meadows store dense, long-lived carbon and are still being lost. National laws and voluntary carbon standards exist, but sites keep disappearing and payouts rarely reach the people who keep them. The ocean commons' first working module: an open registry of sites, evidence and keepers.

boundaries.notes: Each site in data/blue-carbon/ carries its own boundary; the commons is their union, starting with the Atlantic Rim.

terms: Blue carbon ecosystem (established): mangrove, tidal marsh or seagrass meadow, as in the IPCC 2013 Wetlands Supplement.
Emerging: other coastal and open-ocean carbon approaches, carried with evidence but never credit-ready in the registry.

rules.name: VM0033 Methodology for Tidal Wetland and Seagrass Restoration
rules.instrument: Verra VCS methodology (v2.1; v3.0 in consultation 2026)

remuneration.mechanism: Ocean Climate Fund micro-funding for missing evidence; credit revenue through standards; the Gaia virtual ocean layer
remuneration.local_value: Set per site with its keepers.
